units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:2">B. Kam. X, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 114a:6">114ᵃ</cite>) <he>לא יקוץ את סוֹכוֹ וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="O00299"><he>שׂ׳</he></cite>; Y. ed. <he>הסוֹכָה</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 100) he must not cut off the bough of his neighbor’s tree &c. Y. Keth. II, end, 27ᵃ <he>בשׂוֹכוֹ</he> when the bees have settled on his neighbor’s bough (or bush); a. e.—Pl. <he>סוֹכִים</he>, constr. <cite ref="O00303"><he>סוֹכֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 13b:9">Succ. 13ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 3:5">Tosef. Maasr. III, 5</cite> <he>ס׳ תאנים</he> boughs of fig trees.

<cite ref="Eruvin 101a:6">Erub. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ קוצים וכ׳</he> boughs of thorn-bushes and bundles of twigs of which one made a movable hedge before a breach; Tosef. ib. XI (VIII), 11, <he>חבילי וסיכה של קוצים</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>סוכה</he>); v. <cite ref="O00299"><he>סוֹכָה</he></cite>.
